papers.title: Cambrian-P: Pose-Grounded Video Understanding
papers.authors: Jihan Yang, Zifan Zhao, Xichen Pan, Shusheng Yang, Junyi Zhang, Bingyi Kang, Hu Xu, Shang-Wen Li, Saining Xie
papers.affiliations: New York University; UC Berkeley; Meta FAIR
papers.intro: Cambrian-P通过为视频MLLM引入逐帧可学习的相机姿态令牌和姿态回归头，以轻量级姿态监督显著提升了空间推理和通用视频QA性能，同时实现了流式相机姿态估计的最先进结果。

papers.title: MotiMotion: Motion-Controlled Video Generation with Visual Reasoning
papers.authors: Lee Hsin-Ying, Hanwen Jiang, Yiqun Mei, Jing Shi, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Zhixin Shu
papers.affiliations: University of California, Merced / Adobe Research
papers.intro: 本文提出MotiMotion，一个将运动控制重构为“推理‑生成”问题的框架，利用免训练的视觉语言模型（VLM）推理器细化稀疏用户输入并规划合理的次级运动，再通过置信度感知控制调节轨迹引导强度，从而生成因果一致、物理合理的交互视频。

papers.title: AwareVLN: Reasoning with Self-awareness for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.authors: Wenxuan Guo, Xiuwei Xu, Yichen Liu, Xiangyu Li, Hang Yin, Huangxing Chen, Wenzhao Zheng, Jianjiang Feng, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua University, China
papers.intro: AwareVLN通过引入一种在关键导航节点触发的结构化自我意识推理机制和自动数据引擎，使VLN模型在保持端到端数据驱动的同时，具备显式的进度感知、错误修正和可解释规划能力，显著超越现有方法。

papers.title: Sensor2Sensor: Cross-Embodiment Sensor Conversion for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Jiahao Wang, Bo Sun, Yijing Bai, Vincent Casser, Songyou Peng, Zehao Zhu, Meng-Li Shih, Xander Masotto, Shih-Yang Su, Kanaad V Parvate, Tiancheng Ge, Linn Bieske, Dragomir Anguelov, Mingxing Tan, Chiyu Max Jiang
papers.affiliations: Waymo（主要），合作机构包括Johns Hopkins University, Google DeepMind, University of Washington
papers.intro: Sensor2Sensor 提出一种跨实体传感器转换范式，利用4D Gaussian Splatting重建AV日志生成配对训练数据，再使用条件扩散模型同时生成多视角图像和LiDAR，从而将野外单目行车记录仪视频转换为高保真多模态传感器日志。

papers.title: DecQ: Detail-Condensing Queries for Enhanced Reconstruction and Generation in Representation Autoencoders
papers.authors: Tianhang Wang, Yitong Chen, Wei Song, Zuxuan Wu, Min Li, Jiaqi Wang
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University, Shanghai Innovation Institute, Fudan University, Westlake University, JD.COM
papers.intro: DecQ通过在冻结VFM的中间层上附加少量可学习查询（detail-condensing queries），经交叉注意力提取浅层和深层细粒度特征，在几乎不增加计算开销的前提下，同时显著提升重建质量和生成性能，解耦了RAE中固有的重建-生成权衡。

papers.title: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression
papers.authors: Jung Yi, Minjae Kim, Paul Hyunbin Cho, Wooseok Jang, Sangdoo Yun, Seungryong Kim
papers.affiliations: KAIST AI, Naver AI Lab
papers.intro: 本文提出WorldKV，一种无需训练的框架，通过世界检索（基于相机/动作相关性有效召回历史KV缓存）和世界压缩（基于键-键相似性修剪冗余标记）两个组件，在保持实时推理吞吐量的同时匹配或超越全KV缓存的长期记忆保真度。

papers.title: Conceptualizing Embeddings: Sparse Disentanglement for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Piotr Kubaty, Patryk Marszałek, Łukasz Struski, Adam Wróbel, Jacek Tabor, Marek Śmieja
papers.affiliations: Jagiellonian University, Warsaw University of Technology
papers.intro: 提出CEDAR，一种无需增加维度、通过可逆变换与top-k稀疏瓶颈对预训练视觉语言嵌入进行后处理解耦的方法，使语义信息集中到轴对齐的少量坐标上，兼顾重建保真度与人类可解释性。

papers.title: Slimmable ConvNeXt: Width-Adaptive Inference for Efficient Multi-Device Deployment
papers.authors: Janek Haberer, Jon Eike Wilhelm, Olaf Landsiedel
papers.affiliations: Kiel University, Germany; Hamburg University of Technology (TUHH), Germany; UNU-INWEH, Germany
papers.intro: 论文提出Slimmable ConvNeXt，利用ConvNeXt的现代设计（层归一化和反转瓶颈结构）实现无需可切换归一化的宽度自适应推理，在ImageNet-1k上以更低的计算量（GMACs）达到超越现有ViT和CNN可扩展方法的精度。

papers.title: SEGA: Spectral-Energy Guided Attention for Resolution Extrapolation in Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Javad Rajabi, Kimia Shaban, Koorosh Roohi, David B. Lindell, Babak Taati
papers.tags: text-to-image, image generation, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: University of Toronto, Vector Institute
papers.intro: 提出SEGA，一种无训练、内容感知的动态注意力缩放方法，通过在每个去噪步骤分析潜变量的空间-频谱结构来逐维度调节RoPE缩放，从而同时改善高分辨率生成的结构连贯性和细节保真度。

papers.title: What Does the Caption Really Say? Counterfactual Phrase Intervention for Compositional Data Selection in Vision-Language Pretraining
papers.authors: Hyejin Go, Semi Lee, Hyesong Choi
papers.affiliations: Soongsil University, Seoul, Republic of Korea
papers.intro: 本文提出Counterfactual Phrase Intervention（CPI），一种短语级别的数据筛选框架，通过受控的非词替换生成图像条件下的短语敏感度分数，用于从全局对齐池中选择短语级支持更强的图文对，在不修改目标函数的情况下提升组合性预训练效果。

papers.title: Foresee-to-Ground: From Predictive Temporal Perception to Evidence-Driven Reasoning for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.authors: Zelin Zheng, Xinyan Liu, Ruixin Li, Antoni B. Chan, Guorong Li, Qingming Huang, Laiyun Qing
papers.tags: video search, multimodal learning, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Harbin Institute of Technology, Weihai; City University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: F2G将视频时间定位重构为可验证的"先识别后测量"（Identify-then-Measure）问题，通过预测性时间感知构建候选事件段证据池，并让LLM基于可引用的证据单元进行边界预测，从而将黑盒时间戳回归转变为结构化、可归因的推理过程。

papers.title: MLLMs Know When Before Speaking: Revealing and Recovering Temporal Grounding via Attention Cues
papers.authors: Dazhao Du, Liao Duan, Jian Liu, Tao Han, Yujia Zhang, Eric Liu, Xi Chen, Song Guo
papers.tags: video search, multimodal learning, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Xi'an Jiaotong University, Tencent
papers.intro: 本文通过注意力头敲除实验发现MLLMs中存在稀疏的"时间定位头"（TG-Heads），揭示了模型在预填充阶段已知道正确时间区间但在解码阶段丢失该信号的"感知-生成鸿沟"，并提出一个无需参数更新的推理时"读取-再生成"框架来恢复这一隐藏信号，从而提升视频时间定位精度。

papers.title: MM-Conv: A Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Context-Aware Grounding in 3D Dialogue
papers.authors: Anna Deichler, Jim O'Regan, Fethiye Irmak Dogan, Lubos Marcinek, Anna Klezovich, Iolanda Leite, Jonas Beskow
papers.affiliations: KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, Sweden
papers.intro: 该论文构建了一个包含6.7小时VR沉浸式对话的多模态数据集（4,211个引用表达式），并提出一个先进行对话歧义消除再进行视觉定位的模块化两阶段接地管道，相较端到端方法在代词等模糊引用上性能提升近一倍。

papers.title: SceneGraphGrounder: Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding via Structured Scene Graph Matching
papers.authors: Xuefei Sun, Xujia Zhang, Brendan Crowe, Doncey Albin, Christoffer Heckman
papers.affiliations: University of Colorado Boulder
papers.intro: 提出SceneGraphGrounder框架，将3D视觉定位重构为查询图与重建3D场景图之间的结构化图匹配问题，通过视觉标记提示策略从2D视图提取关系并提升为持久3D场景图，实现零样本、可解释的定位。

papers.title: Improving 3D Labeling in Self-Driving by Inferring Vehicle Information using Vision Language Models
papers.authors: Steven Chen, Shivesh Khaitan, Nemanja Djuric
papers.affiliations: Aurora Innovation, Inc
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于VLM的零样本方法，通过单个前向推理同时完成车辆制造/型号/代际识别（VMMGR）和3D尺寸推断，为手动标注生成更准确的种子3D边框，从而提升自动驾驶标注流程的效率和质量。

papers.title: BEiTScore: Reference-free Image Captioning Evaluation with an Efficient Cross-Encoder Model
papers.authors: Gonçalo Gomes, Bruno Martins, Chrysoula Zerva
papers.affiliations: Instituto Superior Técnico, University of Lisbon; INESC-ID; Instituto de Telecomunicações
papers.intro: 提出BEiTScore，一个基于轻量级交叉编码器（从VQA检查点初始化）的无参考图像描述评估指标，结合对抗性LLM数据增强和两阶段训练，在多个基准上达到与LLM指标相当甚至更优的与人类判断的相关性，同时推理速度快30-100倍、模型轻20-60倍。

papers.title: AVI-HT: Adaptive Vision-IMU Fusion for 3D Hand Tracking
papers.authors: Ziyi Kou, Ankit Kumar, Mia Huang, Taylor Niehues, Vatsal Mehta, Ergys Ristani, Li Guan
papers.affiliations: Meta Reality Labs
papers.intro: 本文提出AVI-HT，一种通过跨传感器深度注意力机制自适应融合第一人称视觉与手套上6-DoF IMU信号的方法，在手物交互场景下比纯视觉方法显著降低了3D关键点误差。

papers.title: Hierarchical Variational Policies for Reward-Guided Diffusion
papers.authors: Kushagra Pandey, Farrin Marouf Sofian, Jan Niklas Groeneveld, Felix Draxler, Stephan Mandt
papers.affiliations: University of California Irvine
papers.intro: 通过将扩散模型的测试时引导重新表述为层次变分模型，将控制摊销到轻量级随机策略中，实现少步采样并保持高质量，从而在感知质量与推理速度之间取得显著优于现有测试时缩放基线的权衡。

papers.title: Look-Closer-Then-Diagnose: Confidence-Aware Ultrasound VQA via Active Zooming
papers.authors: Yue Zhou, Erxuan Wu, Yikang Sun, Hongjoo Lee, Yuan Bi, Huixiong Xu, Zhongliang Jiang
papers.affiliations: 未明确（各作者所属机构不同，见"作者机构"部分）
papers.intro: 本文提出一个模拟超声医生认知流程的框架，通过"缩放到病灶再诊断"（Zoom-then-Diagnose）范式和基于组相对策略优化（GRPO）的不确定性感知奖励，实现病灶聚焦推理与置信度对齐。

papers.title: Ablate-to-Validate: Are Vision-Language Models Really Using Continuous Thought Tokens?
papers.authors: Tianyi Zhang, Mahtab Bigverdi, Ranjay Krishna
papers.affiliations: University of Washington
papers.intro: 本文提出 Token Replacement Test（TRT），通过系统性地替换连续视觉 token 内容（零、随机、首重复、真值等）来诊断 VLM 是否真正利用 token 信息，并在多个 backbone 和现成系统上发现准确率提升是误导性代理——模型几乎不依赖 token 内容。
